newsitem.title: USA: Koppers CEO/pres Donald Traviss resigns.
newsitem.headline: Koppers CEO/pres Donald Traviss resigns.

text.p: Koppers Industries Inc said Tuesday that its president and chief executive officer, Donald Traviss, has resigned, effective today.
The company said that Traviss left the company voluntarily to pursue other career objectives.
Koppers said it named Robert Wagner, current chairman of the board and former CEO, to serve as acting chief executive while the company looks for a replacement.
Koppers is a producer of carbon compounds and treated wood products used in the chemical, railroad, aluminum amd steel industries.
